audience.zh: 会写一点 Python，但还没独立写过模型。
audience.en: You know some Python but have not built a model yourself.

task.zh: 先手算两个张量相加的 shape，再用三个小数组验证。
task.en: Predict the shape of a broadcast addition, then check three small arrays.

task.zh: 用两三个 token 标出 Q、K、V 和输出的形状，不急着写完整模型。
task.en: Label Q, K, V and output shapes for a few tokens before building a full model.

task.zh: 先用循环算距离，再做向量化；检查重复点和平局。
task.en: Start with loop-based distances, then vectorize. Test duplicate points and ties.

audience.zh: 学过模型原理，想检查自己能不能独立写对。
audience.en: You know the concepts and want to test your implementation skills.

task.zh: 标清 shape，加 causal mask，再验证未来 token 不会影响前面的输出。
task.en: Track shapes, add a causal mask, and test that future tokens cannot affect earlier outputs.

title.zh: 找出能运行的 shape 错误

task.zh: 比较 [B,1] 和 [B] 的相减结果，写一个会抓住错配的测试。
task.en: Compare subtraction with [B,1] and [B] targets. Write a test that catches the mismatch.

task.zh: 先读懂输入和输出，再用不同 batch size 检查汇总结果。
task.en: Trace inputs and outputs, then check the aggregate result across batch sizes.

audience.zh: 知道模型在预测 token，想弄懂后训练具体改了什么。
audience.en: You know next-token prediction and want to understand post-training.

task.zh: 写出 user 和 assistant 的 token、shift 后的 labels，以及哪些位置算 loss。
task.en: Write user and assistant tokens, shifted labels, and the positions included in the loss.

task.zh: 分别说清 Q-learning、PPO、DPO 需要什么数据、改什么量。
task.en: For Q-learning, PPO and DPO, identify the required data and the quantity being updated.

task.zh: 挑几个样本，写下它们在奖励什么行为，以及什么行为还测不到。
task.en: Inspect a few examples: what behavior do they reward, and what remains untested?

audience.zh: 做过训练，想把数据、目标和工程选择连起来。
audience.en: You have trained models and want to connect data, objectives and implementation.

task.zh: 用一条多轮对话验证 loss mask、结束符和 label shift，写出错误的影响。
task.en: Use one multi-turn conversation to verify loss masks, end tokens and label shifts.

title.zh: 讲清 reference 和 old policy

task.zh: 分别解释它们的用途、什么时候更新，以及混用会改掉什么目标。
task.en: Explain each role, when it updates, and how confusing them changes the objective.

task.zh: 给定显存和卡数，比较 DDP 与 FSDP，并列出换框架后的正确性检查。
task.en: Given a memory budget and GPU count, compare DDP and FSDP and list correctness checks.

audience.zh: 会调用模型 API，想看懂服务背后发生了什么。
audience.en: You can call a model API and want to understand the service behind it.

task.zh: 用一小段 prompt，画出第一次计算和后续每个 token 用到的缓存。
task.en: Use a short prompt to draw the first pass and the cached state used for later tokens.

task.zh: 从入口画到 scheduler、KV cache 和模型执行；每层写一句职责。
task.en: Trace the entry point, scheduler, KV cache and model execution; give each layer one job.

task.zh: 比较 DDP、FSDP、vLLM 各自解决什么问题，别把它们当同一层的替代品。
task.en: Explain what DDP, FSDP and vLLM solve without treating them as interchangeable layers.

audience.zh: 接触过部署，想练系统拆解和取舍。
audience.en: You have deployment experience and want to practice system tradeoffs.

task.zh: 用同一个请求比较调度和缓存，再挑一个差异深入解释。
task.en: Compare scheduling and caching for the same request, then explain one difference in depth.

title.zh: 估一次 KV cache 显存

task.zh: 写明层数、KV heads、长度、batch 和精度，检查 GQA 如何改变估算。
task.en: State layers, KV heads, length, batch and dtype; check how GQA changes the estimate.

title.zh: 设计一个有意义的压测

task.zh: 固定输入输出长度分布，区分 TTFT、decode 延迟和吞吐，再说怎么定位瓶颈。
task.en: Fix the length distribution, separate TTFT, decode latency and throughput, and plan bottleneck checks.

audience.zh: 刚开始刷题，先掌握几种常见结构。
audience.en: You are starting coding practice and want a few dependable patterns.

title.zh: 想清 hash map 存什么
title.en: Choose what a hash map stores

task.zh: 用 Two Sum 解释为什么先查再存，再加一个重复元素的测试。
task.en: Explain why Two Sum looks up before inserting, then test repeated values.

task.zh: 找第一个 ≥ target 的位置；测空数组、重复值和找不到的情况。
task.en: Find the first value ≥ target; test empty input, duplicates and missing targets.

title.zh: 同一张图走 DFS 和 BFS
title.en: Run DFS and BFS on one graph

task.zh: 画出栈和队列的变化，解释什么时候标记 visited。
task.en: Trace the stack and queue and explain when nodes become visited.

audience.zh: 常见题型做过，想检查边界、复杂度和迁移能力。
audience.en: You know common patterns and want to test boundaries, complexity and transfer.

task.zh: 写出 map 的含义，检查负数、零和重复前缀；说明为什么不是滑动窗口。
task.en: Define the map invariant; test negatives, zero and repeated prefixes. Explain why not a sliding window.

title.zh: 把递归 DFS 改成迭代

task.zh: 比较访问顺序、状态保存和额外空间，再用带环图验证。
task.en: Compare traversal order, saved state and space, then test on a cyclic graph.

task.zh: 输出拓扑顺序并检测环，区分依赖层和真正的并行调度。
task.en: Produce a topological order, detect cycles, and distinguish dependency layers from scheduling.
